selection: Paper-era roots plus only the Top-1 and unseen-workload Top-3 memory histories required by active empirical figures; obsolete alternatives were removed and provider credentials were redacted from legacy history JSON files.

known_exceptions.indirect_system_twitter: Uses all five measured March 13 Twitter/System histories recovered from the TPC-C misplaced-file backup. The submitted plot used a synthetic IPC-plus-5-percentage-point substitution; the artifact does not use that proxy.
known_exceptions.memory: Top-1 and unseen-workload Top-3 use results_rag histories; missing Sysbench App/No-Memory is sourced from the regular paper App-only Sysbench OLTP result. Last-1 and non-unseen Top-3 alternatives are intentionally not retained.
known_exceptions.latency: Reuse checked-in latency_by_params.csv as requested; live-provider samples are not required.
known_exceptions.memcached_motivation_table: Out of scope by maintainer direction.
